name: feishu-remote
description: Remotely control local Antigravity from Feishu / Lark mobile or desktop via WebSocket long connection (no public IP required), with CardKit 2.0 streaming, multi-turn sessions, directory/model/mode controls, MCP push & cloud doc tools, and desktop completion handoff hooks. / 通过飞书长连接在手机上远程操控本机 Antigravity，附带飞书 MCP 主动推送、云文档读写与任务完成提醒 Hook。
suggestedPrompts: Set up and start the Feishu Remote Control bot (帮我配置并启动飞书远程控制机器人)
Check Feishu Remote daemon status and recent logs (查看飞书远程控制后台服务状态和最近日志)
Package the feishu-remote plugin into a clean shareable zip (帮我把 feishu-remote 插件打包成可分享给朋友的 zip)
